content.title: How Chuck Norris Secretly Cheated Death in Frantic Medical Emergency Years Before His Passing (Exclusive)
content.text: Chuck Norris stared death in the face — and was zapped back to life TWICE within minutes — years before his death at age 86.The National Enquirer has exclusively learned the martial arts legend suffered two massive heart attacks in July 2017 and endured a frantic 240-mile dash by ambulance and helicopter to get medical help that saved his life.“This would have easily killed most men half his age,” a source tells the Enquirer.The terrifying ordeal began after the beloved Walker, Texas Ranger star made an appearance at the United Fighting Arts Federation’s World Championships in Las Vegas on July 16, 2017.After the event, Norris, his wife, Gena 0’Kelley, and other family members broke up their nine-hour drive home to Chester, Calif., by stopping at the Tonopah Station Hotel and Casino in a remote area of Nevada on July 17.“Chuck’s wife checked the group into the hotel around 1:30 in the morning,” an employee at the hotel’s front desk told the Enquirer at the time. “He was on the casino floor a little while, and then went to his room. Around 5:30 a.m., Chuck collapsed with chest pains while taking a shower.”AdMedia/Newscom/The Mega AgencyAs shocked hotel guests watched, emergency responders rushed The Delta Force star through the casino on a stretcher and into a waiting ambulance.But Norris stopped breathing during a tense 100-mile, high-speed race to Mt. Grant General Hospital in Hawthorne, Nev.Medics jump-started his heart with a defibrillator, while his tearful wife helplessly looked on, sources say.After arriving at the hospital, the karate king suffered a second heart attack. Medical personnel stabilized him once again, and Norris was flown to Renown Regional Medical Center in Reno on a trauma chopper, insiders said.“It was touch and go. I was told his wife was allowed to ride in the med flight with him,” a second source reveals. “Everything happened so fast that it felt like he died twice in 47 minutes!”MEGA“There was so much hysteria it’s impossible to know how long the ordeal lasted. People were watching the heart monitor – not the clock!” the second source says.But true to his image as a superhuman action hero, Norris — who starred with Bruce Lee in the 1972 classic Way of the Dragon — bounced back quickly and was released from the hospital within days.Sadly, Norris tragically passed away following an emergency hospitalization in Hawaii on Thursday, March 19. In a statement shared on Instagram on Friday, March 20, the action star’s family wrote: ““He lived his life with faith, purpose, and an unwavering commitment to the people he loved. Through his work, discipline, and kindness, he inspired millions around the world and left a lasting impact on so many lives.”Read More From National EnquirerThis story How Chuck Norris Secretly Cheated Death in Frantic Medical Emergency Years Before His Passing (Exclusive) first appeared on National Enquirer.
